breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency as specified by the ground truth. The original prompt had a time domain of t in [0, 1.0] but requested an output at T=1.1. The ground truth corrected this by changing the output time to T=1.0. The agent, however, did the opposite: it changed the time domain to t in [0, 1.1] to match the incorrect output time. This is not the correct resolution.
